key_decisions.decision: Keeps commanded word, covenant, and thousand-generation horizon.
Retains gift, named land, and measured inheritance image.
Keeps plural anointed ones and prophetic designation.
Preserves divine agency and the bread-as-staff image.
Makes Joseph's enslavement explicit without erasing providential framing.
Follows the singular read form of foot and physical restraint idiom.
Leaves the antecedent of his word open and retains testing.
Retains the difficult binding verb rather than replacing it with instruction.
Preserves the troubling divine agency and both hostile actions.
Preserves the negative and leaves the plural subject unexpanded.
Keeps firstborn deaths and the reproductive-strength image.
Renders the singular collective request in natural English.
Retains the purpose clause, two instruction terms, and short divine name.
